title: Grateful Dead Live at The Centrum on 1985-11-04
lineage: Nak CR5A>Lunatec V3(analog out)>722@24/96 > Adobe Audition 2.0 dither and resample 16Bit>Cdwav/tracking>flac16
source: Nakamichi CM304's + Beyer M101>Sony Mixer>Sony D5M

ai_review.summary: Warm‑sounding NAK source captures a high‑energy ’85 show with solid sound and good pacing.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praised the recording’s warmth and overall balance, noting that the Nak cassette pull sounds better to their ears than many other ’80s sources. The concert itself is described as having an elevated energy level compared to other 1985 dates, and the second set fits comfortably on a single CD, suggesting a well‑structured performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 4‑star reviews highlight good musical energy and a pleasing sound quality; limited sample size keeps confidence low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as the best‑sounding source by one reviewer, with a warm tonal character despite a slightly bright NAK pull; no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High energy throughout, especially compared to other ’85 shows; set two is concise enough to fit on one CD, indicating a tight pacing.
